---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible software defect (Community is self-service)
---

## Problem
Describe what happened and what you expected.

## Reproduction
List minimal steps using non-sensitive example data.

## Environment
Include Community version or commit, Linux distribution, kernel, architecture and installation mode. For UI issues, include browser version.

## Evidence
Include sanitized errors and relevant diagnostics. Never include secrets, config.env, cookies or private user data. Report vulnerabilities privately using SECURITY.md.

## Checks performed
Describe relevant tests or troubleshooting already attempted.
